body.conclusion: For brief recurring team updates, use a hybrid: one context sentence only when causal or decision context matters, followed by actionable bullets. Bullets alone suit simple updates because they optimize scanning of ownership, blockers, and next steps.

For recurring cross-team status updates, default to 2–4 bullets to make owners, blockers, and next actions scannable. Use a short paragraph for one tightly coupled narrative or decision rationale; even then, end with a clear decision or next step. Use a hybrid brief-update format by default: one concise context sentence when causal framing matters, followed by 2–4 action-focused bullets covering owner, blocker, and next step. Use bullets alone for simple updates; use a short paragraph only for a single tightly interdependent narrative, ending with a decision or next step.
